name: spread-rerank
finding: P2 concurrency (pool.ts): worker selection preceded the reservation queue
mutation: admit uses the outside-queue hint directly (the in-queue confirm falls back to reselect is removed: `const selected = hint`)
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — ranks the second worker after the first reservation instead of joining it
command: npx vitest run test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts --maxWorkers=3 -t "ranks the second worker"

name: terminal-settlement
finding: P2 failure/money (requestWriter.ts): paid-helper settlement read usage only from response.completed
mutation: settlement condition narrowed back to `event.value.type === 'response.completed'` (isTerminalResponseEvent removed)
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — settles known cost from a paid-helper incomplete/failed with usage
command: npx vitest run test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts --maxWorkers=3 -t "settles known cost"
failingAssertion: expected null not to be null (pool claim actual stays unknown)

name: generator-release
finding: P2 lifecycle (requestWriter.ts): paid-helper wrapper never returned its inner generator
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — releases the inner generator when the paid-helper consumer throws mid-stream
command: npx vitest run test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts --maxWorkers=3 -t "releases the inner generator"
failingAssertion: expected false to be true (inner generator finally never runs)

name: rate-limit-forward
finding: P2 validation/money (requestWriter.ts): paid-helper guard never forwarded a 429 to its lease rateLimit
mutation: paidGuard observe override removed (original guard spread through unchanged)
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — forwards a paid-helper 429 to the lease rate limit with its reset time
command: npx vitest run test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts --maxWorkers=3 -t "forwards a paid-helper 429"
failingAssertion: expected "vi.fn()" to be called once, but got 0 times

name: same-lease-retry
finding: P2 failure/compatibility (requestWriter.ts): image 429 retry reused the already-sent lease and hit accountRequestBoundary
mutation: lease.beforeSend throws ownerBusy when hasSent (single-send fence restored)
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — retries an image 429 as a new send on the same lease
command: npx vitest run test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts --maxWorkers=3 -t "retries an image 429"
failingAssertion: Error: A prompt is already running for this conversation.

name: judge-lease
finding: P2 ownership/money (ModelApiHost.ts): same-model Judge used the original client without account admission
mutation: judgeConnection transport.send uses judgeDirectSend only (leased branch removed)
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — sends every paid request on a lease and never on a bare client
command: npx vitest run test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts --maxWorkers=3 -t "sends every paid request"
failingAssertion: expected host source to contain 'await this.judgeLeasedSend(requests, …'

name: image-consent-order
finding: P2 consent/honesty (ModelApiHost.ts): image permission asked spending consent before choosing its lease
mutation: askPaidUse image branch falls through to the unleased allowsPaidUse (early `return true` removed)
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — sends every paid request on a lease and never on a bare client
command: npx vitest run test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts --maxWorkers=3 -t "sends every paid request"
failingAssertion: expected askPaidUse image branch to contain 'return true'

name: stop-words
finding: P2 failure/honesty (requestWriter.ts): retry stop message read current() (queued B) instead of the retry payer A
mutation: stop account falls back to current() (request.retryAccount preference removed)
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — names the retry payer in a stop message while another account is queued
command: npx vitest run test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts --maxWorkers=3 -t "names the retry payer"
failingAssertion: got 'anthropic · b has no room. Resets Oct…' for /· a has no room/

name: main-failed-receipt
finding: P2 failure/money class extension (ModelApiHost.ts): main-turn failed-with-usage never reached its lease receipt
mutation: in-loop accountRequest.receipt removed from streamAttempt (failed event throws before the after-loop receipt)
test: test/unit/accountMainFailedReceipt.test.ts — settles known cost from a failed main response carrying usage
failingAssertion: expected null not to be null (1 response body sent, claim stays unknown)
